## Highlights
### Fixed
- Making a Split View from a single tab now asks you to select at least 2 tabs, instead of asking for fewer. - When Crest can't save your session, Sync settings says why in plain words instead of showing an internal code. - A folder or Space without a name is called Untitled Folder or Untitled Space wherever it comes from, including storage and sync. - Importing another browser's passwords brings those for sites without HTTPS too, and setup says Crest won't fill them in, instead of leaving them out without a word.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
